title: Lead - Server Engineer
description:
Job Summary


We are seeking a highly skilled L3 Wintel Engineer to provide advanced support, administration, and troubleshooting for enterprise Windows infrastructure environments. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Active Directory, core Microsoft services, and virtualization platforms including VMware and Hyper\-V. This role requires deep technical knowledge, problem\-solving capabilities, and experience handling complex escalations.

  

  

Key Responsibilities


1\. Windows Server Administration


Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain Windows Server environments (2012/2016/2019/2022\).


Perform system health checks, patching, upgrades, and performance tuning.


Handle Level 3 incident management and root cause analysis (RCA).


Implement security hardening and compliance standards.


2\. Active Directory (AD) Management


Manage and maintain Active Directory infrastructure.


Administer Group Policies (GPO), OU structures, trusts, and replication.


Perform AD schema updates, forest/domain functional level upgrades.


Manage Azure AD Connect (if applicable).


Troubleshoot authentication, replication, and domain controller issues.


3\. DNS \& DHCP Administration


Configure and manage Domain Name System (DNS) services.


Administer Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) scopes, failover, and reservations.


Troubleshoot name resolution and IP allocation issues.


Maintain DNS zone records and ensure high availability.


4\. Virtualization \& Infrastructure


Manage and support VMware vSphere environments (ESXi, vCenter).


Provision and maintain virtual machines, templates, snapshots, and clusters.


Support Microsoft Hyper\-V environments including clustering and live migration.


Perform capacity planning and resource optimization.


Troubleshoot storage, compute, and network integration issues.


5\. Backup \& Disaster Recovery


Implement and monitor backup strategies.


Perform restoration and DR testing.


Participate in BCP and DR drills.


6\. Monitoring \& Automation


Use monitoring tools for system performance and availability.


Develop PowerShell scripts for automation and administration tasks.


7\. Documentation \& Compliance


Maintain detailed documentation of infrastructure and changes.


Follow ITIL processes for incident, change, and problem management.


Ensure compliance with security and audit requirements.

  

  

Required Skills \& Experience


12 to 15 years of experience in Wintel infrastructure support.


Strong expertise in Windows Server administration.


Advanced knowledge of Active Directory, DNS, and DHCP.


Hands\-on experience with VMware and Hyper\-V virtualization platforms.


Experience in troubleshooting complex enterprise infrastructure issues.


Good knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VLANs, firewalls).


Experience with storage systems (SAN/NAS).


Strong scripting skills (PowerShell preferred).


Experience in production support (24x7 environment preferred).

  

  

Preferred Certifications


Microsoft Certified: Windows Server / Azure Administrator


VMware Certified Professional (VCP)


ITIL Foundation

  

  

Soft Skills


Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills


Excellent communication skills


Ability to handle critical incidents and escalations


Team \& Shift Management and mentoring abilities

title: Salesforce Quality Analyst
description:
**3\+ Years of Experience**
---------------------------


### **Location: Coimbatore**

  

  

### **Role Overview**


We are looking for an experienced **Salesforce Quality Analyst** with 3\+ years of experience in software testing and strong expertise in **Salesforce application testing**. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality, functionality, performance, and reliability of Salesforce solutions across implementation, enhancement, integration, and data migration projects.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Analyze **Salesforce requirements, specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria** to create detailed test plans, test scenarios, and test cases.
* Perform functional and regression testing across Salesforce applications, including **Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and customized Salesforce solutions**.
* Develop and execute **manual and automated test cases** for Salesforce applications.
* Validate Salesforce configurations, including **Objects, Fields, Validation Rules, Workflows/Flows, Approval Processes, Profiles, Roles, Permission Sets, and Reports**.
* Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects using tools such as **Jira and** **Monday.com**.
* Collaborate with **Salesforce Developers, Consultants, Business Analysts, and stakeholders** to investigate and resolve defects.
* Perform **regression testing** for Salesforce enhancements, fixes, releases, and deployments.
* Conduct **API and integration testing** to validate data exchange between Salesforce and external systems.
* Perform **Salesforce data migration testing**, including data validation, data integrity, field mapping, and record reconciliation.
* Validate business processes and end\-to\-end workflows across Salesforce and integrated applications.
* Perform **UAT support** and assist business stakeholders in validating Salesforce solutions against business requirements.
* Monitor and maintain defect logs while performing **root\-cause analysis** for recurring issues.
* Ensure testing activities are aligned with **Salesforce release and deployment cycles**.
* Stay updated with Salesforce platform features, testing tools, QA methodologies, and industry best practices.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of **Salesforce QA processes, test automation, and testing methodologies**.
  

  

### **Qualifications**


* **3\+ years of proven experience in Quality Assurance / Software Testing**, preferably with significant experience in Salesforce testing.
* Hands\-on experience in **Salesforce application testing**.
* Strong knowledge of **manual testing and automation testing**.
* Good understanding of Salesforce configuration and business processes.
* Experience testing **Salesforce Sales Cloud / Service Cloud** or similar Salesforce implementations.
* Strong understanding of **functional, integration, regression, system, and UAT testing**.
* Experience with **API testing tools and methodologies**.
* Experience in **Salesforce data migration testing and data validation**.
* Familiarity with **Agile/Scrum methodologies**.
* Experience with defect management tools such as **Jira,** **Monday.com****, or similar platforms**.
* Strong understanding of test case design, test execution, defect lifecycle, and test result analysis.

### **Preferred Skills**


* Experience working on **Salesforce implementation and customization projects**.
* Knowledge of **Salesforce Flows, Validation Rules, Approval Processes, Profiles, Roles, Permission Sets, and Reports** from a testing perspective.
* Familiarity with **Salesforce APIs, integrations, and external system interfaces**.
* Experience with **Salesforce deployment and release testing**.
* Knowledge of Salesforce\-specific test automation tools or frameworks.
* Salesforce certification such as **Salesforce Certified Administrator** or relevant QA certification is an added advantage.

### **Preferred Attributes**


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to understand complex Salesforce business processes.
* Strong defect investigation and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work closely with **Salesforce Developers, Consultants, Business Analysts, and clients**.
* Ability to manage multiple testing activities and priorities efficiently.
* Self\-motivated and committed to delivering high\-quality Salesforce solutions.
